prompt: In which version of React was the switch from using the id attribute to data-reactid to track DOM nodes implemented?
answer:
The switch was made in **React 0.8.0**. React began using the custom `data-reactid` attribute instead of the standard `id` attribute for its internal DOM-node tracking.

`data-reactid` was later removed in **React 15.0**, when React changed its DOM reconciliation implementation.
